claims: Prairie View A&M University is located in Prairie View, Texas.
Prairie View A&M University is a public HBCU.
Prairie View A&M University was founded in 1876.
Prairie View A&M University is Texas's second-oldest public institution.
Prairie View A&M University has over 9,000 students.
Prairie View A&M University's acceptance rate is approximately 78-79%.
Automatic admission to Prairie View A&M University usually requires a 2.8+ cumulative H.S. GPA on a 4.0 scale.
Prairie View A&M University's tuition for 2023-2024 is approximately $11,299 for in-state students.
Prairie View A&M University's tuition for 2023-2024 is approximately $26,874 for out-of-state students.
Applicants to Prairie View A&M University typically have ACT scores between 16 and 21.
Prairie View A&M University is ranked No. 343 in National Universities by U.S. News & World Report.
Prairie View A&M University's athletics are NCAA Division 1.
Prairie View A&M University has 18 sports.
Prairie View A&M University's sports teams are known as the Panthers/Lady Panthers.
